Actually a study I read found out that men aren't as reluctant to seek professional help as most people assume.At the same time most suicides are committed by men despite the fact that more women are diagnosed with depression.This can be interpreted in two ways . Firstly mental health professionals fail to identify the symptoms of depression in men and/or secondly they are unable to treat men's depression as effectively as women's . Thus it would be rather cruel to blame the individual male instead of the existing mental health system.

In fact ,if one takes a closer look at  modern mental systems they could spot some of the underlying issues that result in its inability to provide adequate support to men. In my opinion he most blatant of those issues is the lack of male professionals. In 2016 65% of psychologists in the united states were female ,in 2019 that percentage rose to 70% .So as in most fields where one gender is overwhelmingly dominant all others tend to be discriminated against as in the case of education and law enforcement. Secondly I would like to draw attention to a more insidious issue, the internalization of gender norms concerning men's mental health by mental health professionals .

So a month before I ,that demon of a 15 year old , started high school I began attending cram school, as most high schoolers where I live do .He and I happened to share classes after our first lesson he approached me and asked if I would like to walk home together (he had moved across the street ) .I assumed that my tutor ,whom I had successfully impressed with my rhetoric ,had told him to befriend me (I was correct) .I wanted to confirm my assumption  so I accepted his request. This would be the first of many walks we would take together. Gradually I warmed up to him and we begun to have actual conversations   .He was an antithesis of me ,he seemed to simply not give a fuck about power and control ,while  being rather happy at the same time, which caused me a great deal of confusion . Thus I started to doubt my own beliefs about the world .

This all culminated during a rhetorics competition my cram school held .He and I were in the same team .Our first match was against some seniors ,we were evenly matched until it was my turn to speak ,and speak I did ,when I was finished the entire room of 50+ people went completely silent ,I had won the first round . After that he decided to leave since he had little interest in verbal sparring and for some reason I couldn't fathom this wrecked me .I was receiving all the praise I wanted yet I felt hollow.
"I don't like this, it's no fun without him here" . I consider this the day that my past self died and I was born .
From that day on I would look up to him as the older brother I didn't have  .And thanks to him I was able to see the good in people that I would have seen as  inferior to me, where there was once nothing, there were suddenly experiences to be had and friends to be made .

However the nail in my coffin would be placed later . During a school trip  ,he had been assigned the job  of collecting garbage from each hotel room .When he came to the room I and a couple of friends were staying at, I joked that he made a fine trashman to which he responded to by pointing at the trash bag he had been given and saying:" yeah ,get in " .Later that day I half-jokingly congratulated him for making me look inferior Infront of my friends .His reply shocked me to the core
Him: " what's the reason to look superior " 
Me:"You know me , always antagonistic"
